results.title: The 2025 Foundation Model Transparency Index
results.snippet: Foundation model developers are among the world's most important companies. As these companies become increasingly consequential, how do their transparency practices evolve? The 2025 Foundation Model Transparency Index is the third edition of an annual effort to characterize and quantify the transparency of foundation model developers. The 2025 FMTI introduces new indicators related to data acquisition, usage data, and monitoring and evaluates companies like Alibaba, DeepSeek, and xAI for the first time. results.title: Efficient Benchmarking in Production: A Study of an Evolving LLM Agent
results.snippet: Production LLM agents are evaluated repeatedly as they evolve, but full agent benchmarks are costly to rerun. We study efficient recurring evaluation for a production analytics agent serving tens of thousands of monthly active users and report first-hand deployment experience. Using 574 historical runs of the production benchmark, split chronologically into calibration and held-out periods, we compare random sampling, historical caching, fixed representative subsets, and IRT-based adaptive testing. The results show that multidimensional 2PL adaptive testing achieves the best overall score fid…

results.title: What Twelve LLM Agent Benchmark Papers Disclose About Themselves: A Pilot Audit and an Open Scoring Schema
results.snippet: We read twelve well-known LLM agent benchmark papers and recorded, dimension by dimension, what each paper actually says about how its evaluation was run. The motivation came from a familiar frustration: two papers will report results on the same benchmark with the same model name and disagree, and you cannot tell why -- the scaffold, the sampling settings, the subset, or the evaluator version. In many cases the published artifact does not let you answer. This paper is an implementation report on the attempt. # Agent 评测与安全（能力基准、欺骗与可纠正性）前沿调研报告

**日期**：2026-10-30（UTC） | **领域**：Agent Evaluation & Safety / LLM Agents / Alignment | **检索源数量**：34 条可引用来源

---

## 1. 进展与热点

### 1.1 基础模型透明度评测：行业整体倒退
2025 年第三版 **Foundation Model Transparency Index (FMTI)** 评估 Alibaba、DeepSeek、xAI 等主流模型开发商，发现透明度平均分从 2024 年的 58 分跌至 40 分（满分 100），训练数据、训练算力与部署后影响披露最不透明 [3]。这为下游 Agent 安全审计构成**基础设施级风险**：若基座模型不透明，Agent 层面的欺骗、可纠正性评测即缺乏可信基线。

| 维度 | 证据 |
|------|------|
| 热度证据 | 引用数待核实；覆盖主流厂商，第三版持续追踪 [3] |
| 权威证据 | arXiv preprint (cs.AI)，Stanford HAI/CRFM 团队 [3] |
| 关注度 | 高 —— 权威机构年度基线，被广泛引用于治理讨论 |
| 推荐度 | ★★★★☆ —— 非专门针对 Agent 欺骗/可纠正性，但为模型层面安全评测提供量化基线 |

### 1.2 生产级 Agent 持续评测工程化突破
首个系统研究生产环境 LLM Agent 的**高效持续基准测试**方法：利用 574 次真实历史运行（按时间分校准期/保留期），在十万月活用户规模下验证低成本重复评估可行性 [6]。解决了「评测成本高、频次低」的工程矛盾，为 Agent CI/CD 提供实证方法论。

| 维度 | 证据 |
|------|------|
| 热度证据 | arXiv 2026-09-18 最新预印本，生产实证数据 574 runs [6] |
| 权威证据 | arXiv preprint (cs.AI)，真实部署十万 MAU 场景 [6] |
| 关注度 | 中 —— 单一生产案例，但工程落地参考价值极高 |
| 推荐度 | ★★★★☆ —— Agent 评测工程化关键参考，适合 CI/CD 集成场景 |

### 1.3 Agent 基准评测可复现性危机被实证揭示
对 12 篇知名 LLM Agent 基准论文的**试点审计**发现：同一基准、同一模型在不同论文中报告结果常不一致；论文普遍未披露脚手架、采样设置、子集选择、评估器版本等关键复现细节 [7]。作者提出**开放评分模式**推动报告规范化。这是当前 Agent 评测领域**核心增量发现**——基准本身不可信，安全评测更无从谈起。

| 维度 | 证据 |

### 3.1 评测报告规范化：从「不可复现」到「开放评分」

### 4.1 评测成本与频次的**结构性矛盾**（瓶颈）
全量基准重跑成本随模型/Agent 迭代呈指数增长 [6]。拐点信号：**蒸馏评测器、主动采样、历史运行复用**等低成本近似评测方法若能在多任务上验证泛化性，将重塑评测工程范式。

FMTI 2025 显示透明度倒退 [3]，训练数据/算力/部署影响「三大黑箱」未开。拐点信号：监管强制披露（如 EU AI Act GPAO 条款）或行业自律标准若落地，将强制打开黑箱。

SAE 训练成本随模型规模增长 [26][27]，nnterp 等接口标准化虽降低工程门槛，但**大模型（>100B）全层 SAE 训练仍不可行**。拐点信号：稀疏编码与注意力头语义化的**联合压缩方法**若突破，将实现千亿参数级可解释性。
